name: modworks
description: Mods for Claude Code, one folder per mod.

plugins.name: cost-guard
plugins.description: Helps long Claude Code sessions use less of your usage limits: a live usage and context pane, automatic compaction at a threshold you pick (your history stays on screen), and trimmed tool output.

plugins.name: ship-gate
plugins.description: Holds Claude's commits, pushes and pull requests until your shipping steps are done for the current code: code review, UX and marketing copy checks, a screenshot or video sent, or steps you add.
